capabilities: sync Wave AI recordings into the vault as Markdown notes
write note properties with title, date, length and a link back to the recording
list action items as a task list with due dates
mirror Wave folders as vault subfolders
configure sync frequency, history range and transcript folding
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant or writing tool; it only syncs recordings from the Wave AI app into the vault as notes.
extras: One-way sync only (Wave to vault, never back); local edits are never overwritten. Offers OAuth browser connect or a manual read-only API token; no analytics. Includes Copy diagnostics for support and a Rebuild notes command for applying new content options.
problem: Recordings, summaries and transcripts made in the Wave AI app stay there, so they can't be searched, linked or reused inside an Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Every recording you make in Wave AI shows up in your Obsidian vault as a Markdown file
Action items as a task list (with 📅 due dates the Tasks plugin understands)

requires.name: Wave account (browser sign-in or API token)

summary: Sync connector that turns Wave AI recordings into Markdown notes with summaries, action items and transcripts, mirroring Wave folders in the vault.
